items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And, man, Hawk was cuttin' everybody out.

ctx.x: I skipped away, and about four of us went over there. And we'd heard about the sessions coming in, you know, so we got there. There was Ben and Herschel and Dick Wilson, about three or four other of the local, you know, and Hawk. And, man, Hawk was cuttin' everybody out. Prez (phonetic) got 'em. And immediately became the talk of the town. Now Prez, after he tore Hawk apart, he tore Hawk up so bad, Hawk missed the date in St. Louis. Hawk was still trying to get him at 12 o'clock that night stand (phonetic)--…
Well, when you--was it sort of his originality of ideas, was it, that --?
